title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani apologises to Jeeva for hiding her marriage with Anbu. Jeeva expresses his pain, saying he cannot forgive her and ends their professional association.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Rishi visits Kalamma's house to take Viji back. Meanwhile, to save Ilamathi's married life, Kumaresan and Gandhimathi file a police complaint against Kalamma for Ashok's murder.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar and Poongodi pose awkwardly in their unromantic photo shoot. Deivanai rejoices while telling Nandhini that the astrologer's prediction of their separation will come true.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Siva misjudges Sindhu when she calls in pain from a scorpion bite. Meanwhile, Sneha and Devaraj plot to take revenge on Sindhu, Siva and Annapurani.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Malar consoles a distressed Lakshmi while making her realise her mistake. Concerned about age-related health issues, Ragavan urges Bagyaraj to arrange a medical checkup for him.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Kathir reveals Saravanan's depression and mental distress to Raji. Sakthivel gets emotional seeing Kumar dressed as a groom on his wedding day.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: The house owner returns the money to Chozhan after his relentless pleas. Seeing his desperate efforts, Vannathi teases him and reveals the incident to Nila.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena is touched by Muthu's kindness as he donates to the orphanage and seeks prayers for her surgery. Seetha hides from Arun's sight when he arrives at the karate institute.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Karuppu and Sethupathi secretly gift a car to Tamizhselvi's family in disguise. Vellathai supports them and purposefully tears her saree, pretending to be helpless to trick Vasanthi.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu angrily rejects Arjun and returns home devastated. Meanwhile, Karikalan throws Arjun out of the house for refusing to marry Swetha.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan blackmails Arivalagan with a video involving his second wife. Arivalagan unseals Kandhasamy's mess, dropping his demand for an apology to his friend.
